hebrewText: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּ/סוֹד קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝/נוֹרָ֗א עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽי/ו

tokens.bdb: strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
tokens.kjv: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'

tokens.bdb: to awe or (intransitive) to dread; hence, to harass
tokens.kjv: be affrighted (afraid, dread, feared, terrified), break, dread, fear, oppress, prevail, shake terribly.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to awe or  to dread; hence
tokens.enLiteralWord: to awe or  to dread; hence
tokens.explanation: to awe or  to dread; hence
tokens.explanationEn: to awe or  to dread; hence

tokens.bdb: a session, i.e. company of persons (in close deliberation); by implication, intimacy, consultation, a secret
sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary
abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
tokens.kjv: (in) abound(-undance, -ant, -antly), captain, elder, enough, exceedingly, full, great(-ly, man, one), increase, long (enough, (time)), (do, have) many(-ifold, things, a time), (ship-)master, mighty, more, (too, very) much, multiply(-tude), officer, often(-times), plenteous, populous, prince, process (of time), suffice(-lent).

tokens.bdb: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
tokens.kjv: affright, be (make) afraid, dread(-ful), (put in) fear(-ful, -fully, -ing), (be had in) reverence(-end), [idiom] see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.
